test_cases.title: Login with email and password on Android
test_cases.precondition: VantageFitness app installed on Android 14 device (Pixel 8); valid staging account exists
test_cases.expected: App navigates to the home screen within 3 seconds; user name shown in the top bar
test_cases.actual: Login succeeded in 2.1 seconds; home screen displayed with correct user name
test_cases.notes: Tested on Pixel 8 (Android 14) and Samsung Galaxy S23 (Android 13)

test_cases.title: Login with biometric authentication (fingerprint)
test_cases.precondition: Device has fingerprint enrolled; user previously logged in with 'Remember me' on this device
steps: Open the VantageFitness app after a previous authenticated session
When prompted, use fingerprint to authenticate
test_cases.expected: Fingerprint authentication succeeds; user is logged in and taken to the home screen
test_cases.notes: Biometric login is not yet implemented in the staging build (feature flag disabled). Scheduled for sprint 24.
